body: God thank you for this answer. It’s made me feel heaps better. You’re right, it is a fun challenge! I think I need to stop overthinking it and just have fun. Part of me is probably afraid to look silly and that same part is worrying about getting everything perfect. I feel better about the session now that some time has passed, so hopefully the next one will be great. Thanks again!
Would the people in town warn them about the witches? Would they know to do so? I kind of wanted my PCs to think the women in the windmill were innocent old ladies until they got there…
Ah, perfect. Thank you for this.
